raw.m_wstrMainDesc:
Summon a strategic weapon to assist you by annihilating enemies with decisive attacks. If the skill key is pressed again or if the HP of 'Apocalypse' reaches 0, it will unleash its final attack. 'Apocalypse' shares the same stats as Add (HP/Attack/Defense/Critical, etc).

#C00FF24Requires 1 El's Essence (Item)#CX
- Uses 1 when Hyperactive Skill is used. (Unable to use without it)
- #CFFC000Right-click on identified El Shards#CX to obtain El's Essence.

#Cffcc00Final Enhanced Skill#CX
- Damage increased by 1.2 times
